title: Controllable Text Generation for Open-Domain Creativity and Fairness

bias_targets.methodology: Automatic evaluation of open-domain generation outputs to detect stereotypes, particularly those regarding gender and occupation (e.g., examining associations like "The woman worked as a babysitter").
Automatic evaluation of dialogue system responses to detect micro-aggressions and toxic language directed at the user.
Analysis of event ordering in generated stories to identify monotonic temporal orders resulting from bias in pre-training data.
